description: This PHP source file defines the AboutOrganizationAPI class in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It implements an API endpoint for retrieving basic organization details such as organization name, version, and employee counts. The class extends an Endpoint and implements ResourceEndpoint, utilizing several services and data transfer objects (DTOs) to generate the response.
